notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.8
notes.content:
[p]A few minor fixes and a QoL tweak or two this time-

[/p][list][*][p] Up to 8 pages of save games now supported (hopefully enough for the save-early-save-often folks!). 
It only shows the first few pages until you fill them up to keep the UI clean.
[/p][/*][*][p] Notification option added to Accessibility menu, so you can disable the red number for Topic Notifications, or turn them off completely.
[/p][/*][*][p] Typo fix- Effected -> Affected.
[/p][/*][*][p] Text tweak to match VO when grinding coffee.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed rare soft lock in Ch4 when [spoiler]talking to detective about Nazari[/spoiler].
[/p][/*][*][p] Fix for partial photograph description updating early in Ch7.
[/p][/*][*][p] Some glitchy animation fixed at end of Ch 6 for [spoiler]Roth and Hara [/spoiler].
[/p][/*][*][p] Ch7 Interface Lab description now set correctly for [spoiler]Hara[/spoiler].
[/p][/*][/list][p]I'm about to head on a long-awaited trip to Japan with the family for a few weeks, so no more finding bugs until I'm back! ;)  [/p][p][/p][p]Laters, [/p][p]Dave[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
Got caught up in a bunch of business admin tasks this week- the joys of being a small indie team :P

But found time for a few quick fixes:

[list]
[*]VSync option now saves/restores correctly.
[*]Notification setting saves/restores correctly.
[*]Fixed Ä character font issue in German credits.
[*]Reporter description updates correctly [spoiler]when you see her in the vent shaft[/spoiler].
[/list]
If you have the soundtrack, I've added an optional lossless (FLAC) version of the tracks there too. And it's also [url=https://powerhoof.bandcamp.com]on Bandcamp now[/url] if you tend to look for soundtracks there, or just want a listen!

Cheers,
Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
Found some time to hack in a few extra options people have asked for. I'll add these to the options menu properly later, but thought I'd update with just keyboard shortcuts for now, since I had a couple of bug fixes to publish too.

[list]
[*] Added Vsync option in the Limit Framerate slider (drag it to the left). New installs default to vsync on rather than limited to 60fps.
[*] Shift+F now toggles CRT Filter. (Will be added as separate option in menu later)
[*] Shift+T now toggles Topic notification setting between On, Minimal and Off. (Will be added as separate option in menu later). So you can turn of the red number notifications if you want.
[*] Fix for potential soft-lock in chapter 9 [spoiler]where Roth floats off the screen[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed incorrect description in chapter 7 [spoiler]when Roth is in the interface lab[/spoiler].
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
Another bunch of fixes. You keep findin' em, I'll keep patchin' em!

[list]
[*] Fixed walk-to point for cutlery drawer with gamepad.
[*] Fixed potential soft-lock in hospital [spoiler]after Hara knocked out[/spoiler].
[*] No longer have to leave and return to find something behind the generator.
[*] Changed "carotid" back to "cartoid" to match colloquial way Mick says it.
[*] Fixed Butcher sprite being flipped.
[*] Removed drop-shadow under Mick on winch.
[*] Fixed "0" topic notification.
[*] Fixed potential soft-lock walking back into the Vent at start of Ch8.
[*] Stopped you being able to walk with keyboard while dialogue GUI is active.
[*] Fixed mouth alignment for Detective and Annie in some poses.
[*] Typo fix for Geiger counter description.
[*] Fixed a dead character still being able to talk in Ch6.
[*] Geiger counter sound and animation fixes.
[*] Geiger counter no longer reads low when should be high in one instance.
[*] Fixed missing German localisation descriptions of doors in Ch7.
[*] Stopped player from walking to the right in the corridor [spoiler]with Sophia[/spoiler] in Ch9.
[*] Music volume no longer plays full volume in the lab when it's turned down in settings.
[*] Fix for hard-lock in Ch7 on bridge [spoiler]if using inventory together while Alec is talking to you[/spoiler]. Hopefully fixes some other super-rare soft-lock issues with background sequences too.
[*] Fix for flamethrower sound effect potentially never ending.
[/list]

I'm getting through most of the issues people have been reporting. Most of the remaining ones are super-rare now afaik. But if anyone has hit a soft-lock somewhere and needs a save game to get past it, email me on the support email on the steam page and I can hook you up.

Thanks everyone for playing, it's been amazing to get such a great reception to the game!

- Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Working through a bunch more bugs, don't mind me...

[list]
[*] Some potential fixes for Mac display issues (Set to native retina display on first launch) to see if it helps with some reported issues there.

[*] Fixed my own name in the credits lol.
[*] Mick can no longer say the caretaker's inside the office when he's not.
[*] Swapping answering machine tapes in a certain way no longer causes the description to be wrong.
[/list]

- Dave

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
It's been an awesome launch, thanks everyone for your support! I finally got some sleep and now I've fixed a few issues that some folks ran into-

[list]
[*] Fix for potential softlock where player could get stuck and couldn't move in Chapter 3 cemetery.
[*] Fix for potential softlock in Chapter 6, waiting for a timed event.
[*] Music/Sfx/Dialogue sliders now save/restore correctly.
[*] Fix for dialog option not working with Sarah in Chapter 4.
[*] Typo fix "bill" -> "Bill"
[/list]

Thanks for those reporting bugs in the forums, and especially for going out of their way to help with sending save games for diagnosing the trickier ones.

- Dave

notes.title: Investigate The Drifter Demo during the Steam Mystery Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Something's rotten in the city of Mawson.[/h3]

We've been working hard on The Drifter, and the Steam Mystery fest felt like a great time to show off some of what we've been doing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/7dcb654de6f46a17373cf02e215bbf1fc6aca19e.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Demo[/h2]
The updated demo is live, so if you've missed it so far, you have this week to check it out!  If you've played before, it's the same section, but with some spit and polish and a trailer at the end teasing never before seen gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/526cb6652f53eb8f2c50c15a93ac0d4e994977fe.gif[/img]

[h2]New screenshots[/h2]
We've got a bunch of new screenshots we're sharing on the steam page too, so check it out if you haven't for a while. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/06b5749587f5a2b6a54c4eb4070b2adb829d4a44.gif[/img]

[h2]Steam deck support[/h2]
The game's also running great on Steam Deck, with it's unique dual-stick interaction controls, if you have a deck, be sure to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050221/5c68db5b1df0184e8fe223fae8c23fd58288ec92.gif[/img]

[h2]Progress[/h2]

The game's still a while away from releasing, or even announcing a release date... but the whole game is playable with placeholder art and temp dialog, and we have 3 artists on board now, so we're starting to really churn through content!

To keep up to date with development, or if you just wanna hang and chat, [url=https://discord.gg/powerhoof]jump in our discord[/url]!

Cheers!
Dave
